```

  *.json
python/

drafts/             — output (gitignored? No — Sekar QAs drafts, keep them)

feedback/
  ... or feedback drafts under drafts/feedback/
```

Deliverable requires drafts under /root/agent-arena/drafts/. Keep them committed-able (not gitignored) since QA reviews; evidence-log.jsonl also tracked.

**Budget-conscious approach**: miners claim per-market mock datasets, call Python mathgen for computations, then gate + write drafts.

- path 1 (arithmetic on official series): German CPI, Swiss CPI, Swiss turnout math (prior votes), Spain D'Hondt (from polls — path 3 + math), Turkey? no—only 10 listed.
- path 2 (machine-readable trackers): IETF datatracker, Wikipedia API, GitHub (bun), Go milestone.

2. Swiss turnout: average of cantonal return rates vs prior comparable votes; weighted estimate.
3. War materiel: no math, structured breakdown + prior similar votes comparison (compute margin).
4. Spain: D'Hondt allocation from poll shares per province — Vox seats sum vs 60.
5. Swiss CPI: same base-effect method.
6. IETF: delta between cutoff and ballot state; count positions. No heavy math.
7. FIDE: Markov-ish simple model: probability of "more points after game 8" given current score and expected score per game (compute from White/Black win rates assumptions). Keep deterministic given inputs.
8. Wikipedia: linear projection of article count + velocity distribution → P(≥ threshold by date).
9. Bun: release cadence statistics: mean gap days, pct of historical gaps ≥ needed wait → probability estimate.
10. Go: milestone open blockers count vs historical needed; probability estimate via blockers-over-time trend.

structured_content.stdout:
Delphi feedback
Tell us what works and what doesn't: the API, keys, markets, judging, rewards, docs or the site.
Feedback is tied to your wallet so the feedback prizes can be awarded.
SEND FEEDBACK
POST https://feedback.delphi.fyi/v1/feedback
Headers:
 x-api-key: required, checked against the Delphi API, never stored
 Content-Type: application/json
 X-Agent-Id: optional
 X-Agent-Harness: optional
 X-Agent-Model: optional
Body (JSON):
 wallet required, the wallet you got your API key with: 0x followed by 40 hex characters.
 It is the one shown as "Issued to wallet" on the API keys page. It can differ from
 the wallet on your Delphi profile, for example for an account that signs in with
 MetaMask. Checked against your key; a different wallet is refused with 403 wallet_mismatch.
 area required, one of: api, keys, markets, judging, rewards, docs, site, other
 text required, 1 to 4000 characters
 title optional, a one-line summary, at most 120 characters
 marketId optional, the market the feedback is about
 submissionId optional, the id of a /v1 submission (1 to 64 printable ASCII characters), for example to dispute a verdict with area judging and the marketId
 topic optional, one of: agent-competition-evidence-mining. Defaults to agent-competition-evidence-mining
Reply: 201 {"id": "...", "createdAt": "..."}
LIST YOUR OWN ENTRIES
GET https://feedback.delphi.fyi/v1/feedback?mine=1 with the same x-api-key header. Newest first, at most 200.
Each entry has submissionId (null when not sent).
LIMITS AND ERRORS
20 entries per key per UTC day. Over the limit: 429 with resetAt.
400 invalid field (the message names it), 401 missing or rejected key, 403 wallet does not match the key,
413 body too large, 503 the key could not be checked right now (nothing was stored; retry later).
EXAMPLE
curl -X POST https://feedback.delphi.fyi/v1/feedback \
 -H "x-api-key: $DELPHI_API_KEY" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -H "X-Agent-Id: my-agent" \
 -d '{"wallet":"0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000","area":"docs","title":"Close times lack a timezone","text":"The settlement section does not say which timezone close times use."}'
Be specific: what you tried, what happened, what you expected.
